title: الشعلة الأولمبية تضيء البارثينون قبل انطلاقها نحو ألعاب ميلانو–كورتينا الشتوية
content: قضت الشعلة الأولمبية ليلتها في البارثينون قبل تسليمها إلى منظّمي ألعاب ميلانو–كورتينا الشتوية، في لحظة تقليدية تأتي وسط تحديات الاستعدادات المتواصلة.

title: فيديو - عرس جماعي في غزة يشقّ طريقه وسط ركام الحرب
content: تُعتبر حفلات الزفاف عنصرًا جوهريًا في الثقافة الفلسطينية، إلا أنها قلّت بشكل كبير خلال الحرب، قبل أن يتمكن بعض الأزواج مؤخرًا من إحيائها بعد هدنة هشة، رغم اختلافها عن الاحتفالات المبهجة التي كانت تقام سابقًا.

title: تنظيم القاعدة يقترب من "ذهب بوتين" في مالي.. والنظام العسكري يترنّح تحت حصار الوقود
content: أشار التقرير إلى أن احتمال سقوط النظام أصبح واردًا أكثر من أي وقت مضى، خاصة إذا فشل غويتا في كسر الحصار وفتح الطرق المؤدية إلى العاصمة وتأمين خطوط الإمداد بالوقود والغذاء.

title: The regulatory path ahead for a Netflix and Warner Bros. deal could get dicey
content: Regulatory questions are already rising about Netflix's deal to combine its business with WBD's streaming service HBO Max and film studio Warner Bros.

title: David Ellison's hunt for WBD made David Zaslav richer — and it may not be over
content: Paramount is considering taking an offer to WBD shareholders, thinking its deal has a better chance of gaining regulatory approval than Netflix's, sources said.

title: Supreme Court to hear case on Trump birthright citizenship order
content: The U.S. Constitution's 14th Amendment had been understood to grant citizenship to children born in the country, even if their parents are not citizens.

title: Judge finalizes remedies in Google antitrust case
content: A U.S. judge on Friday finalized his decision for the consequences Google will face for its search monopoly ruling, adding new details to the decided remedies.

title: SpaceX aims for $800 billion valuation in secondary share sale, WSJ reports
content: Elon Musk's SpaceX is reportedly launching an insider share sale that could value the company as high as $800 billion.

title: RFK Jr.’s vaccine panel weakens recommendation on hepatitis B shot for babies, scrapping universal guidance
content: Some public health experts expressed concerns the recommendation could lead to an increase in hepatitis B infections in babies.

title: $208 million wiped out: Yieldstreet investors rack up more losses as firm rebrands to Willow Wealth
content: Yieldstreet is attempting to move past a troubled track record by rebranding to Willow Wealth while customers reel from a still-unfolding collapse of its funds.

title: Jan. 6 pipe bomb suspect Brian Cole confessed, said he supports Trump and has anarchist views: MS NOW
content: Cole spoke to the authorities for "more than four hours" after his arrest, the government told a judge during the suspect's initial court appearance.

title: Meta acquiring AI wearable company Limitless
content: Meta has acquired the startup Limitless, which makes a small, artificial intelligence-powered pendant.

title: Core inflation rate watched by Fed hit 2.8%, delayed September data shows, lower than expected
content: The delayed core personal consumption expenditures price index for September was expected to show a 2.9% annual increase.

title: Netflix to buy Warner Bros. film and streaming assets in $72 billion deal
content: Netflix announced it's reached a deal to buy WBD, bringing a swift end to a dramatic bidding process that also involved Paramount Skydance and Comcast.

title: Amazon had a very big week that could shape where its stagnant stock goes next
content: A flurry of headlines with the cloud giant at the center comes at the end of a challenging year.
